def luhn_valid(text):
    # Check if text is a nonempty string consisting only of ASCII digits
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
        raise ValueError(\"Input must be a nonempty string\")
    
    if not text.isdigit():
        raise ValueError(\"Input must consist only of ASCII digits\")
    
    # Implement Luhn algorithm
    # From the right, leave the rightmost digit unchanged, 
    # double every second digit, subtract nine from doubled values above nine
    total = 0
    for i, digit in enumerate(reversed(text)):
        if i % 2 == 1:  # Every second digit from the right (0-indexed from right)
            doubled = int(digit) * 2
            if doubled > 9:
                doubled -= 9
            total += doubled
        else:  # Rightmost digit and others not doubled
            total += int(digit)
    
    # Return True if sum is divisible by 10
    return total % 10 == 0
EOF"
